gen.title: From compression to power stroke
gen.orderNote: Follows the mechanical order described from compression through ignition to power stroke

steps.label: Mixture compressed for ignition
steps.quote: At the end of the compression stroke the fuel/air mixture has been compressed into the combustion chamber
steps.orderHint: Mixture is ready before valves close

steps.label: Valves and contact close
steps.quote: The intake valve and exhaust valve are closed and the electrical contact is closed.

steps.label: Contact opens to begin combustion
steps.quote: The combustion process begins by opening the electrical contact through the action of the ignition cam and springs.

steps.label: Spark ignites mixture
steps.quote: As the contact moves away from the plug, a spark is produced which ignites the mixture.

steps.label: Rapid combustion at constant volume
steps.quote: The combustion proceeds so quickly that we can consider the piston to be motionless and the volume of the combustion chamber to be a constant.
steps.orderHint: Volume stays constant while heat releases

steps.label: Combustion ends and power stroke begins
steps.quote: The end of the combustion process is designated Stage 4 of the engine cycle and is the beginning of the power stroke.
steps.orderHint: Marks the start of useful work
